definition: Yang Song is the creator of Score-Based Generative Modeling and Consistency Models.
details: Formulated diffusion models through Stochastic Differential Equations (SDEs) and invented fast single-step Consistency Models at OpenAI. Yang Song (born 23 June 1989 in Yuxi) is a Chinese tumbling trampoline gymnast, representing his nation at international competitions. He won medals at world championships, including at the 2009, 2010, 2011, 2013, 2014 and 2015 Trampoline World Championships. He took up gymnastics in 1995, and began trampolining in 2000 in Yunnan Province. He was named an International Elite Athlete by the General Administration of Sport of China in 2008.
